nota: Kept externo: cattle traceability is commodity-chain traceability with commercial destination, though the object of the item is which agency regulates it.
Kept domestico: FAO report referenced, but the object is domestic deforestation; an international body is not an external-market frame.
Kept externo, borderline: audit of SENASA sanitary management including the animal identification and traceability system.
Kept externo: traceability programme for ractopamine use in pig production, part of the livestock traceability apparatus.

Recoded externo -> domestico. Minimum-standards environmental bill (presupuestos minimos) on agrochemical traceability: environmental-control instrument with no external-market referent. The lexical rule fired on TRAZABILIDAD.
Recoded externo -> domestico. Same instrument as HCDN213062.

Recoded domestico -> externo. Requests an import ban on pork produced with ractopamine: explicit external-trade referent (ingreso a la Republica Argentina). The lexical rule has no pattern for INGRESO.
Confirmed eudr: describes the regulation (marketing and export of products associated with deforestation and forest degradation on the EU market).
Confirmed externo: same instrument as HCDN283348 (entry into force of the Resolution 71/2024 system); coded identically for consistency.

Kept domestico, borderline. Names REDD+, an international climate framework, but the object is a provincial programme and no market, buyer or export is named; coded like other references to international bodies (FAO) without a market frame.

Recoded eudr -> ue_otro. The register of establishments supplying cattle for slaughter for export to the EU is sanitary-traceability apparatus created by SENASA Resolution 370/1997 and re-established by Resolution 53/2017, twenty-six years before Regulation 2023/1115; it also appears as established framework in the recitals of SAGyP Resolution 71/2024 (B.O. 17-10-2024). Title names the EU but not the deforestation regime.
Confirmed eudr: names Regulation 2023/1115 and its suspension.

Recoded eudr -> externo. The individual electronic traceability system was created by SAGyP Resolution 71/2024, whose recitals invoke global consumer demands and sanitary management and do not mention Regulation 2023/1115 or deforestation; Resolution 19/2025 postponed it on device-supply grounds. Multi-market instrument, not EU-specific.
